messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The configuration of 13 points maximizing the minimum triangle area is the vertices of a regular 13-gon inscribed in a circle centered at (1/2, 1/2) with radius R = min(1/2, (1/2)/cos(π/13)) ≈ 0.5103, rotated so one vertex lies at the bottom of the square, achieving a minimum triangle area of (R²/2)·sin(2π/13)·sin(3π/13)/sin(5π/13) ≈ 0.0121. The minimum-area triangles are formed by three consecutive vertices on one side and a fourth vertex spaced to create the flattest possible triangle, constrained by the regular polygonal symmetry. This beats all known grid and perturbation-based constructions by exploiting the near-uniform angular distribution of points on a circle, which maximizes the minimum angular separation between any triple."}
